% Pattern: theorem/newtheorem/article. An environment with an empty title,
% numbered within the theorems, that the paper uses for the claims of a proof.
% The paper prints only the number, as 1.1 within Theorem 1: the claims
% of its proof.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=thm-1
% want stat-1 statement/claim 1.1
% want stat-2 statement/claim 1.2
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{stat}{}[thm]
\begin{document}
\begin{thm} Each tree with two vertices is a path. \end{thm}
\begin{proof}
\begin{stat} The tree has one edge. \end{stat}
\begin{stat} The edge joins the two vertices. \end{stat}
Both give the path.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
